independent_claim_concepts.concept: A system comprising a skill-authoring authority, a skill-DNA registry, a proof-scoring engine, a class-promotion registry, and an operator-gated handoff generator.
A method of generating skill DNA, registering the skill DNA, verifying proof artifacts, calculating a respect score, assigning an earned class, and enabling a gated money-preparation phase.
Instructions that cause one or more processors to create, validate, promote, and audit skill-DNA records under a canonical authority rule.

claim_risk_notes: Avoid claiming only an abstract idea.
Tie claims to concrete data structures, validation steps, gating steps, audit records, and technical enforcement.
Separate legal/business labels from technical mechanism.
